Best value of the three: the MSI Modern 14 (C7M-062IN) at ₹43,219 because it is the only one with 16GB RAM.

MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN, ₹43,219: Ryzen 5 7530U, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14-inch screen (from the name).
Acer Aspire Lite 15 AL15-41, ₹42,990: Ryzen 5 5625U, 8GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 15-inch screen (from the name). Cheapest, but an older chip.
MSI Modern 14 C7M-284IN, ₹45,990: Ryzen 5 7530U, 8GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14-inch screen (from the name). Same chip as the first, with half the RAM.

The price list gave no exact screen details, so I took the sizes from the AI names. Check the resolution on the shop page before you buy. Want me to look up the screen details for these three?
